content: hyprpanel (AGS/TypeScript bar; docs site partially unreachable, list from project knowledge corroborated by wiki ecosystem guidance): bar+dropdown control surface: dashboard (power actions, favorites), QuickSettings menu (volume, brightness, night light, DND, bluetooth toggle, wifi/vpn, theme light/dark), per-domain dropdown menus (network, bluetooth, media, calendar, notifications, battery info), cpu/ram/temperature bar modules, wallpaper picker/migrator. Proves appetite for GNOME-like quick settings on Hyprland; it is a bar, NOT a settings app - Archel can own the full-editor side.
